title.zh: 斡旋方推美伊5日互让协议，重开海峡换解除海上封锁
title.en: 斡旋方推美伊5日互让协议，重开海峡换解除海上封锁

current_state.zh: Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani envoys met Iranian officials in Tehran to back Qatari and Pakistani mediation for a proposed five-day US-Iran deal trading the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz to commercial vessels for the lifting of the US naval blockade on Iranian ports.
current_state.en: Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani envoys met Iranian officials in Tehran to back Qatari and Pakistani mediation for a proposed five-day US-Iran deal trading the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz to commercial vessels for the lifting of the US naval blockade on Iranian ports.
